A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EvoQuality study. All 14 pages are readable, including equations, figures, tables, references and the final appendix/LLM-use disclosure. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–14 are identical.

before.justification: v4 reports original IQA experiments, benchmark comparisons, multi-dataset training results and ablations in Section 4, Tables 2–5 and Figure 3.

after.justification: v5 retains the same original empirical results in Section 4, Tables 2–5 and Figure 3.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same offline pairwise majority voting and online fidelity-reward GRPO procedure. No model component, objective or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions retain KONIQ-based training, evaluation on SPAQ, LIVEW, AGIQA, CSIQ, TID2013, KADID and PIPAL, and the KONIQ/SPAQ/KADID co-training experiment.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparator sets in Tables 3 and 4 are identical, including the handcrafted, deep-learning and VLM-based methods. Table 5 retains the same EvoEstimate comparison.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols and settings are unchanged, including PLCC/SRCC metrics, two evolution rounds, 20,000 image pairs per round and 32 sampled responses in the main experiments.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the EvoEstimate ablation in Table 5 and the candidate-response study with K = 1, 8, 16 and 32 in Figure 3. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. The method's candidate-response sampling and variance calculations are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All result entries and reported trends in Tables 2–5 and Figures 1 and 3 are unchanged. For example, EvoQuality Round 2 retains a TID2013 PLCC of 0.674 in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 and their accompanying mathematical definitions and reasoning are identical. No theoretical material is added in the appendix.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the same claims about fully self-supervised IQA, the reported 31.8% PLCC improvement, outperforming supervised VLM-based models on five of seven benchmarks, and augmenting pretrained IQA models.

C2.justification: Sections 4.2–5 retain the same interpretations concerning ranking, generalization and iterative refinement. Limitations concerning the unlabeled image pool and computational overhead are unchanged.

D1.justification: v5 adds an abstract sentence identifying github.com/bytedance/EvoQuality as the future location of code and checkpoints; v4 provides no such pointer. This adds access information, but the future-tense statement does not establish that these resources have been released.

R1.justification: The related-work section, cited works and reference list are identical. The positioning relative to self-consistency methods and ranking-based IQA is unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 adds one closing sentence to the abstract and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining wording, section organization and appendix disclosure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract sentence changes first-page line wrapping and shifts Figure 1 and its caption slightly downward. Figure content and styling are retained, and all subsequent page layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The new repository pointer modestly improves documentation by giving readers a specific destination for the promised code and checkpoints. The scientific content, evidence and appendix material are unchanged. Actual artifact availability is not established by the PDFs, so the supported benefit is limited to the access information.
